classify_change.why_narrows_a_false_positive_not_a_true_: The ONLY documents whose shape changes are those carrying the complete 7-key unit contract: they cannot have a unit-shape gap, so the move cannot forgive a missing key. Measured: 22 documents change shape, all 7/7 unit keys, all gap-free in the unit shape; 13 of them are the reported regressions, the other 9 (e.g. U10.json, V2W.json) already satisfied BOTH contracts and were merely labelled verifier. No document moves from unit to verifier, and no unit-shape gap set changes.

companion_edit.why: The old form measured each exemption against {gaps of that shape}, so a document that changed SHAPE vanished from the live set and its exemption read as 'repaired'. It now measures the DOCUMENT against the exemption's own contract. Same verdict for a same-shape repair (measured shrinks, the check fires as before), so the check still bites; different only for a shape move, which is not evidence of a repair. Only V-R2VLLM-TRIAGE.json and VLLM-CELL.json are affected, and both still lack overall+checks (measured == exempted), so they are unreachable, not satisfied; if either regains the verdict shape AND those keys the check fires.

classify_change.diagnosis_correction: The HANDOFF-BASELINE-REGEN hint's proposed rule (V-prefix + unit key set + no verdict-shaped key overall/verdict -> unit) explains only 8 of the 13. It leaves 5 mis-shaped: RECORD-REFRESH.json, VERDICT-DISPUTE.json, VERDICT-REFUSAL-SEMANTICS.json (unit key set AND overall) and V3-PILOT.json, VERDICT-ADOPTION.json (unit key set AND a 'verdict' key). The rule that explains all 13 is precedence by DOCUMENT COMPLETENESS: full unit key set -> unit, regardless of name or extra keys; otherwise name/overall -> verifier. Every one of the 13 carries all 7 unit keys and declares status, so this was never a missing-key defect.

residual_stated_not_hidden: An ambiguous document (all 7 unit keys + overall) is classified unit, so it is not asked for the verifier-only key 'checks'. Recorded in docs/HANDOFF-SHAPE.md and in classify()'s docstring; bounded because one unit key short and the document falls through to the verdict test (test_ambiguous_shape_cannot_smuggle_a_missing_key).
